current_quest.name: The List
current_quest.on_the_page: The Confessors' list of the Faithless at Saint Ysolde's was read aloud at the inn in Coldmere; Hollis's name is second on it, and asked who was first, Wren only looked at Darrow. Rae Thorne, who drives the House's last cart, heard it read and climbed through the night to bring it up. While Old Mercy, the sanctuary bell, rings at dawn and dusk, no blade may climb the Steps or pass the gate; miss one ringing and the law lapses till the next. At Darrow's word the winch-brothers have carried a story down to the valley, that the Faithless went down the far side a week ago, and Mother Ione has held Old Mercy since the council, because a bell rung for nobody tells the valley there's somebody. When the grey cloaks are at the bars, Darrow is to tell Wren when. They came in three bells early: six grey cloaks, their cart and a censer are at the winch-house at the foot of the Steps, and one of them sits on Rae's cart with his boots on the board. Rae could have gone down past them while the road was open, and did not.
current_quest._about: on_the_page is what the site shows and must be supported by the chronicle; the GM's own summary lives in saga/state/_gm/plan.json (quest_summary)

current_struggle: The soft season. The knee feels well, and Maelis says that is exactly the danger: the thread is softest now, and the quiet is a liar. He can walk to the chapel and back without the stick; he cannot kneel, and he has asked fifteen times to go down the Steps and been told no fifteen times, the last at the Prior's council.
last_beat: At noon on the wall-walk by the gate, through Pell's glass, a grey cloak climbed onto Rae's cart at the winch-house and put his boots up on the board. Darrow told her to go down while the rest were an hour out, ask him off her box and be on the road to Coldmere by dark; she said "Aye" to all of it. When he said he had asked fifteen times to go down those steps and she could walk down them today, she did not say aye, and waited until the five were in. When he said that had been her road, she said the first two names on that list rode up in her cart.

maelis.note: has told him what she dared, and not where she learned it

hollis.note: on the list, second; drinking less this week

choices.text: Tell the lay brothers the Faithless went down the far side a week ago. Let the valley carry it.

inventory: a borrowed stick he refuses to use

recaps._about: One-line 'previously' per chapter file slug, shown at the top of that chapter in the reader. Spoiler-free; only what earlier chapters showed.
recaps.01-the-confessor-at-the-steps: At Harrow Ford the Grace went out of the Ninth Lance in mid-river and did not come back, and Darrow's knee gave way with no blade near it. Carried up the Thousand Steps to Saint Ysolde's, he chose Maelis Vorne's Binding over kneeling again at the Oathspire.
